name: Dream Sugar Honey
original_name: ドリームシュガーハニー
source:
Kikuchi Hiroyuki wanted to commit suicide, but couldn't. Instead, he kept on living solely out of habit. One day, he meets Mizushino Masumi, a beautiful young man, in a entertainment district.

[Translated from [url=https://tubumame.booth.pm/items/1396416]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
菊池裕之想要自杀，却不能。相反，他只是出于习惯而继续生活。某天，他在娱乐区遇见了美少年水筱真澄。

[译自[url=https://tubumame.booth.pm/items/1396416]BOOTH[/url]]
